author: BastardSamurai
quote:
Waste of money. I'm actually done with AAA games at this point. Too many companies are using their legacy to bait and switch.

30FPS in 2026 is a joke.

Activists being invincible is insane. This is a game about doing unhinged CRIME. I shouldn't have my immersion broken when I come across invincible characters because some people may have their feelings hurt. 

Not being able to shoot up the clubs/bars is ridiculous. What is the point of this? Bars are some magical sanctuary where crime doesn't exist? 

Trains stopping on a dime when you put someone on the tracks. 

Planes bouncing off buildings like padded walls.

Spending hours doing chores for a bossy, annoying, unlikeable woman. 

If your only benchmark for a good game is graphics, I guess this is okay. It's nothing spectacular in my opinion, but it looks alright. At 30FPS. 

Some people are going to dismiss this as chud/incel whining, and that's okay. They are too far gone to be reasoned with. However, not everything needs to be a vehicle for virtue signaling. We don't need to tone GTA down and use it to spread a message. These games are supposed to be a break from reality where we can use our imaginations to do ridiculous and funny things. If the entire game's purpose is to be violent and engage in crime, then political guardrails shouldn't be put into the game. Just let people be unhinged and do as they please. 

I wish I had the foresight to see this coming and avoid wasting my money. I guess now I know for the future. 

RIP Rockstar. Hire some people that aren't brainwashed zombies. Or watch as another company rises to take your place.
